analysis.description: This waiting area features a modern minimalist design with a large curved mirror mounted on a glass wall, reflecting both the indoor and outdoor environment. The space is characterized by clean lines, a wooden floor, and a sleek, uncluttered layout. The design does not incorporate traditional Indian elements, focusing instead on contemporary aesthetics and functionality.
